title: A data- and compute-efficient chest X-ray foundation model beyond aggressive scaling

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot classification performance and dataset label distributions across common versus rare (long-tailed) thoracic diseases to evaluate if the model biases learning toward over-represented diagnostic patterns.

Analyzing the distribution of patient ages (e.g., pediatric vs. older adults) in the curated training subset compared to the full dataset to check for unintended demographic sampling biases introduced by the data curation process.

Comparing the distribution of patient racial categories (White, Asian, Black, Pacific Islander, Native American, Other) between the full training set and the curated subset using the CheXpert dataset to ensure the active data curation process does not introduce unintended racial bias.
